5.1.7: one command prefix for DIH and automation

- Use `.structure`, `.autosleep`, `.seedinput`, `.mine`, `.goto` and the rest of the automation command registry directly. No separate `#` prefix is required; the selected DIH prefix applies across both command systems.
- Add automation commands and aliases to native command discovery and argument completion. Alias-specific actions remain intact, including the distinction between navigating home and saving a home.
- Search names, aliases and descriptions with `.commands <search>`. Use `.help <command>` for full automation usage and examples.
- Keep native DIH meanings when names overlap. `.baritone <command>` reaches every automation command or setting, and qualified names such as `.baritone:ai` remain discoverable in help and completion.
- Keep `.` selectable with Meteor installed. Known DIH commands take precedence; Meteor-only roots continue to reach Meteor. Existing custom DIH prefixes are retained.
- Enable the compatible DIH completion path on Minecraft 1.21.11.
- Show automation guidance with the selected prefix, while retaining legacy command compatibility for existing macros.

Includes the 5.1.6 script-read performance fix and all existing release targets.
